svg.title: Ancient isoparametric flows in Euclidean space
svg.desc: Exact two-radius product evolution at three physical times, projected from ℝ⁴. The two circle radii evolve independently as stated in the formula; projection crossings do not change embeddedness.
svg.text: Exact formula in a labeled projection
Common spatial scale · teal: profile / slice · rust: second piece / asymptote · gray: reference geometry
